en_US: Hello? I can’t hear you very well...
We must have a bad connection...
Try calling me again from a different
location, please.
Hello... How are you?
I’m doing well, thanks.
There are so many other Trainers out
there who are much stronger than me...
You should challenge them and see.
Let’s see...
I’m usually free on Wednesdays
around noon. I could spare some time...
Why don’t you call me again then...
Amphy’s gotten better lately. I’ve also
been able to take some time to myself.
What do you think? Would you like to
battle me again? {YESNO 0}
Got it...
Well, I’ll see you in Saffron City at the
Fighting Dojo, OK?
Huh?
Before you battle me again, don’t you
have other appointments to keep?
Got it. I’ll be waiting at the Fighting
Dojo in Saffron City.
I’ll see you there.
This is Jasmine.
How do I sound? Healthy?
You didn’t forget about your promise to
meet me for a battle, did you?
I’m still waiting for you at the Fighting
Dojo in Saffron City...
Have you been to the Lighthouse lately?
I’ve been so busy myself. I haven’t
been able to get over there to see
Amphy much...
But...whenever I see the Lighthouse’s
lights at night, I always think,
“I hope you’re doing well, Amphy.”
Um...
There’s something I’ve been meaning to
ask you... What did you think of my Gym?
Was the atmosphere a little strange?
But...I mean, steel always looks
pretty cold and uninviting, but I was
trying to make it at least a little cute.
Warden Baoba at the Safari Zone...
He came over to my Gym once to
introduce himself...
He talks a little differently, doesn’t
he? I heard it’s called anastrophe...
